name: Lord Serpentis
summary: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Lord Serpentis leads the Druids of the Fang. Once a mighty druid in Naralex's order, he fell to madness when Naralex's dream soured in the cavern springs. Now he helps command the serpent-worshipping sect near the corrupted Naralex, who lies slumbering.

sections.title: From Noble Druid to Serpent Lord
sections.body: Before the cavern springs darkened, Serpentis held great power and prestige as a druid. He belonged to the noble order led by Naralex. Together, they hoped to heal the Barrens with the springs and the Emerald Dream. But Naralex's vision became a corrupting nightmare, and its rising madness took hold of Serpentis and the other druids.

sections.title: A Lord of the Fang
sections.body: Naralex's twisted dreams spread corruption through his followers. Serpentis and the others became the Druids of the Fang, abandoning Cenarion balance and the totem animals of old. Now they seek to remake the Barrens in the image of their twisted dreams instead of healing it. Serpentis shares leadership with Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn and Lord Pythas.

sections.title: The Final Obstacle
sections.body: Deep in the winding caverns, Lord Serpentis guards one of the four dream gems carried by the rogue sect's leaders. To wake the trapped master or reclaim the waters of the Oasis, Serpentis must be defeated and his gem taken. Only then can the serpent's hold over the labyrinth be broken.

faq.answer: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Lord Serpentis is one of the four leaders of the Druids of the Fang. Once a night elf druid of great power and prestige in Naralex's order, he fell to Naralex's nightmare along with his fellow druids.
Naralex's attempt to heal the Barrens through the Emerald Dream became a nightmare. Its corruption spread among the druids who followed him, turning Serpentis toward madness and serpent worship.

faq.q: What is his relationship to Naralex?
faq.answer: Serpentis once followed Naralex into the caverns as one of his noble druids. He became a leader of the Druids of the Fang, who now seek to remake the Barrens in the image of their twisted dreams.

faq.q: Why do players need to kill him?
faq.answer: Serpentis is one of the four leaders of the Druids of the Fang. Defeating him breaks the sect's grip on the Wailing Caverns, secures his gem and clears a path toward awakening Naralex.

faq.q: Who are the Druids of the Fang?
aliases: what are druids of the fang
faq.answer: The Druids of the Fang are renegade night elf druids who followed Naralex into the Wailing Caverns. Corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare, they abandoned traditional druidic forms for the aspects, venoms and behaviors of serpents. Serpentis and the other fanglords lead them.

angles.text: As a druid, Serpentis shows the danger within the Emerald Dream. Even a druid of great power can be twisted when a noble vision becomes a nightmare.
For night elves, Serpentis and his followers bring painful disgrace. They were kaldorei scholars of great renown, but abandoned their sacred duty to nature and became monstrous serpent lords.
For tauren, Serpentis's corruption desecrates the Earth Mother's balance. It threatens the Barrens' fragile ecosystem with unnatural madness.
